title: A check-in that waits on CI waits at most 55 minutes, read from one dated constant
why: A wake past the prompt cache lifetime pays to reload the whole context.
source: plan restart-plan (main), coordinator 11:46 CST Nov 12 for lane ruling-parts-cite-steps; R32 part 3 (owner pick c, Nov 11)
note: Rule git-ci-wait-checks-in ("each wider apart") becomes "each wider apart, never past 55 minutes". The cap is read from one constant that names its source and date (the prompt cache lifetime), so a change reaches every caller at once and the claim can be re-checked when it goes stale (owner: "we should keep some sort of tabs on how anthropic determiines warm cash so this doesn't go stale"). Ready, no lane.
